fusions.name: Run-Down Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a link at an enemy up to 5 tiles away and hauls you to it, dealing 13 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Mark
fusions.desc: Casts a link at an enemy at or below 30% health that deals 22 damage and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Leash
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Scent Held
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below 50% health, your damage rises by 15%.
